About Us

Our Story

Since 2012

Higher Education
Serving students of Ambedkar Nagar and the surrounding regions with degree programs built for both careers and further study.

Established in 2012, welcome to Bhagwati Prasad Mohini Devi PG College. We're committed to providing quality, higher education to students of Ambedkar Nagar and the surrounding regions. Since then, we've been shaping young minds with a focus on academics, values, and career growth.

With state-of-the-art infrastructure and experienced faculty, we offer B.A, B.Sc, M.A, M.Sc, and other degree programs that prepare students for both jobs and higher studies.

Our Vision

To be a centre of excellence in higher education, empowering students with knowledge, skills, and values to become responsible citizens.

Our Mission

  1. Provide affordable, quality education to all.
  2. Develop critical thinking and communication skills.
  3. Create a safe, inclusive, and green learning environment.

From this campus, to the world you will go. With knowledge in hand, and confidence to show.

Dr. Ambalika Sharma
Principal  ·  M.A, Ph.D
